source_frozen: ROC-02 twelve 240-update original SHA-256-pinned checkpoints and exact source splits, merged PR #114
sealed_test_access: FORBIDDEN: do not load, use, infer labels, or tune from sealed_test_inputs; no test outcome or headline ROC-02 claim
state_time: after entire event sequence and floor(depth/2) of the post-sequence tied residual updates
suffix: remaining floor(depth/2) updates; actual recurrent depth 8 or 16 even

observer_basis.supervised: top-k left singular vectors of centered train midpoint states transpose times centered train one-hot task labels, with orthogonal residual PCA fill when k>8
observer_basis.pca: top-k right singular vectors of centered train midpoint state matrix
observer_basis.frozen_head: original trained eight-way readout, no recalibration, for future-output Jacobian and counterfactual output margins
observer_basis.ridge_head: train-only centered rank-k eight-output ridge, alpha=1, evaluated on calibration inputs only

jacobian: dense T=D(f_post^suffix)(h_mid), D=T-I, checked against reverse-mode JVP
blocks: A=U^T D U; B=U^T D(I-P); C=(I-P) D U, rank-invariant Frobenius quantities and normalized against ||D||F
causal_H: H=T^T R^T R T, R=original model.readout.weight; s=tr(U^T H U)/tr(H)

nulls.method: CPU Gaussian orthonormal QR or SVD

p_family: a_low,b_low,c_low,b_high,s_high,s_low, inclusive rank-p=(1+count_extreme)/129 and Holm across all six directions
null_thresholds: Use ROC-01 Amendment C exactly: rank-conditional ratios and abstention on undefined denominators; avoid unlabeled global statuses

causal_interventions.state_source: same single h_mid for paired arms; output via original frozen eight-way readout after suffix
causal_interventions.main_endpoint: L2 logits displacement; pairwise task-label margin displacement
causal_interventions.linearization: compare finite-radius change with R T delta; separate actual model from tangent

rank_objective: calibration-only task MSE and task accuracy of ridge-decoded label vs null-relative B², lambda=1 preselected; report rank/MSE/B true three-coordinate non-dominated candidates
new_rank_optimizer: No leakage-penalized learned U in this first audit; training equal-budget 80-update arm remains untested and is mandatory before prospective sealed test
full_status: Calibration-only diagnostic with original trained 12 neural weights, not final ROC-02; report all six-seed counts and no generalization claim
stop_conditions: invalid new labels or sealed usage
resource_limit: CPU PyTorch single thread, no paid GPU
publication: commit source, per-state nulls, per-seed summaries and hashes in new PR; keep PR draft until independently reviewed
